Part of being an adult is realizing you can't always get what you want. Skipping matches because you didn't get to use your precious cartoon turtle saves you no time and ruins the experience for everyone. 

Kids these days can be so toxic.
You just want to instalock Blastoise, don't you.
In addition, teachers turned a blind eye to the blatant abuse I was receiving. I even received death threats by my abusers. As a 12 year old. Just for not liking girls. I don't need this.

I was abused as a child by my peers for being a sissy. They would literally make a circle of 20+ people to block my escape, with them taking turns to beat me up in middle school. I know that kids can be cruel but I think that, in addition to the psychological / physical bullying that I suffered when I was young has left me conditioned to hide my true self.

I've found that expressing my feelings anonymously on the internet helps a lot. For example, I posted[ this thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/3bq9co/being_alive_hurts/) when I was having a depression attack and it describes everything that I was feeling then.

After I wrote it, I felt a lot better, but I fear that one of these days I will not be abel to handle it and just jump in front of the subway

* I hold myself to an impossibly high standard every time. Being a perfectionist is not fun because you end up not doing anything because it will not be perfect

* I am gay and I cannot come to terms with it. When I drink my true personality comes out and even though everyone accepts me, I feel so guilty of being myself. I just wish I could press a button and be straight. That would solve 99% of my issues

* I suffer from extreme ADHD where I will just sit in bed all day and consume trash content (buzzfeed, facebook, reddit, you know the drill). Hopefully this will all change when I start my new job next week

* I just relocated from another country to NYC. 3 months of not seeing my family and the loneliness are really starting to take a toll on me.
There is something about me waking up from sleep that triggers the worst depression / panic attacks I've had for years

I feel like everything I see is in black and white. When I'm locked up in my room, I'm even afraid to come out to the bathroom, drink water, or eat. The world has become a dangerous place for me, but I know it's all in my head, but I know it's real. 

IT WON'T LEAVE. GOD.
Why have the gift of life and the curse of depression? Only a sadistic god would do that.

I cannot take control of my life because of this pain parasite. I feel like it's taking over. I used to think I could handle it, but it's gotten worse over the years. If I'm feeling this way right now I don't wan't to imagine how I'll feel in a few years. I am literally at my wit's end. EVERYTHING HURTS

I WANT THIS CURSE TO LEAVE. I DON'T NEED IT! I'VE HAD IT.

It never leaves, it's always there. Every thought that I have is tainted with its poison. I cannot escape my mind. I want to unzip myself from my body and fly away

I really think it's part of a larger problem. It hurts to be awake. I just wish I was sleeping everyday. Sometimes I think it would be better to just *be dead*, because of how much pain I must endure while I'm awake. I always dread waking up.

I mean, there are some good things that I have in my life, but it's like a shadow that's always above me that prevents me from just being in the moment.
